accent: One global accent track (AC, leftmost on the panel) programmed per step like an instrument. It makes no sound; it raises every voice on that step. One ACCENT LEVEL knob sets the amount. No per-voice accent.
global_features: No shuffle/swing and no humanise (Music Technology 1986)
No flam (none documented)
Tuning: only the three tom/conga TUNING knobs; tuning is not programmable per step
Pre-scale selector (listed on Roland's TR-08 page; number of positions not confirmed here)
Basic Variation A/B and Intro/Fill-in; 12 basic-rhythm + 4 fill-in pattern slots in pattern play (iO-808 recreation)
Individual audio outputs per voice (Music Technology 1986)
No MIDI on the original
pack_contents: 82 WAVs plus 82 Ableton .asd analysis files (only pack with .asd). Two naming sets. (1) Plain names, stereo 44.1 kHz/16-bit: Bassdrum-01..05, Snaredrum, Clap, Claves, Cowbell, Cabasa, Crash-01, Crash-02, Hat Closed, Hat Open, Rimshot, Tom L/M/H (18). (2) 'TR-808' prefix, mono 44.1 kHz/16-bit: Kick01-16, Snare01-16, Tom01-07, Conga01-05, Hat_C01-05, Hat_O01-03, Ride01-04, Clap01-02, Rim01-02, Shaker01-02, Clave, Cow (64). Numbers are just variants; names do not state knob settings, but kick lengths run 0.04 s to 2.05 s, so they are probably TONE/DECAY variations (inferred). No mid/hi conga split in names; Crash/Ride/Cabasa/Shaker names do not match 808 panel voices (one CY voice, MA voice). No loops.

accent: AC step track (last position on the instrument selector) applied to all voices on that step; one ACCENT level knob. The pack's Readme says accent adds a subtle overdrive.
global_features: Five voice level knobs for seven sounds ('four of the sounds are squeezed into two'), plus ACCENT, TEMPO and VOLUME
No tone/decay/tuning controls: 'The sounds cannot be edited'
Four SCALE settings incl. triplet-type scales; pattern length settable (e.g. 12 steps)

pack_contents: 55 WAVs + Readme.txt. (1) Plain names, stereo 44.1 kHz/16-bit: Bassdrum, Snaredrum, Tom L, Tom H, Cymbal, Hat Closed, Hat Open (7). (2) 'TR606' prefix, mono: Kick, Snare, TomLo, TomHi, Cymb, Hat_C, Hat_O and Hat_P, each 01-05 plus _OD (48). Readme: 01-05 are five accent levels (1 = low, 5 = high); _OD = overdriven high-accent hits. 'Hat_P' is not a 606 panel voice; its length (0.33-1.07 s) sits between closed (0.11-0.19 s) and open (1.27-1.86 s), so it may be a part-open/'pedal' hat (unknown). Mid tom does not exist on the 606.
